title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

  • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
  • Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 
  • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
  • Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume. 
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
  • Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
KAISCHOOL est une école supérieure spécialisée en Intelligence Artificielle, Data, Cybersécurité et Commerce IT. Elle forme du Bac+3 au Bac+5 en alternance, en mode hybride. Pour développer ses activités data, KAISCHOOL recrute un(e) alternant(e) Expert en Ingénierie des Données. Vous travaillerez sur nos propres projets et préparerez votre diplôme dans notre école.

Votre formation : Expert en infrastructure de données massives (Bac+5)
Il s’agit d’une certification de niveau 7 (Bac+5), enregistrée au RNCP sous le n° 37638 et délivrée par Simplon. Elle forme des experts capables de concevoir, déployer et gouverner des systèmes de données à grande échelle. La formation couvre toute la chaîne, de l’étude de faisabilité jusqu’au data warehouse et au data lake.

Vous apprendrez à :

  • concevoir et administrer des infrastructures de données massives ;

  • construire des pipelines de collecte, de traitement et de distribution des données ;

  • créer et maintenir des entrepôts de données et des data lakes ;

  • industrialiser les traitements avec CI/CD et DevOps Data ;

  • déployer sur des environnements cloud public, privé, multicloud ou on-premise ;

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Engineering Manager

Location: Remote - Europe (CET ±2 hours)

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You'll be joining as an Engineering Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.

As FullEnrich continues to grow, we're investing in the engineering leadership and structure needed to support our next stage of growth. We're looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with technical depth, and who enjoys building high-performing teams, improving how engineers work, and creating the foundations for sustainable growth.

You'll initially lead a multidisciplinary team of up to ten engineers across backend, frontend, and data, taking ownership of their development, performance, and delivery. Working closely with Product Managers and engineering leadership, you'll help translate business priorities into achievable engineering objectives, ensuring teams have the clarity, support, and processes they need to deliver great work.

This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how our engineering organization evolves. As we scale toward 25 engineers, you'll help shape our squad structure, establish effective ways of working, and build an environment where engineers can grow and do their best work. You'll work closely with the VP of Engineering, CTO, and other Engineering Managers, with the autonomy to influence decisions and drive meaningful improvements across the organization.

What You'll Do:

People Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, performance management, feedback, and career development.

  • Build a supportive, high-performing team environment where engineers have clear expectations, opportunities to grow, and the autonomy to do their best work.

  • Take ownership of team health, engagement, and retention, proactively identifying and addressing challenges.

Hiring & Team Growth

  • Own the engineering side of hiring for your squads, including defining requirements, setting assessment criteria, interviewing, and making hiring decisions.

  • Develop effective onboarding processes that help new engineers become productive and autonomous quickly.

  • Partner with engineering leadership to shape team structure, squad ownership, and hiring priorities as the organization scales.

Engineering Delivery & Execution

  • Partner with Product Managers to translate product and business priorities into clear engineering objectives, realistic roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

  • Own engineering delivery across your squads, ensuring work is appropriately scoped, estimated, and delivered with clear accountability.

  • Identify and manage delivery risks, technical dependencies, and competing priorities, keeping stakeholders informed and addressing blockers early.

Engineering Processes & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and continuously improve how your squads operate, using our Discovery → Run lifecycle, inspired by Shape Up, and DORA metrics to measure delivery effectiveness.

  • Establish practical, scalable ways of working that improve predictability, collaboration, and engineering quality without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Collaborate with other Engineering Managers and the VP of Engineering to evaluate and improve engineering processes across the wider organization.

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide technical guidance on architectural decisions, engineering trade-offs, and complex delivery challenges, ensuring teams make well-informed decisions.

  • Work closely with Product, Design, Support, Sales, and leadership to align engineering priorities with business needs.

  • Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly, creating transparency and trust across teams and stakeholders.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend is built in Go (Golang), with Svelte on the frontend, PostgreSQL and OpenSearch for data, and DigitalOcean for cloud infrastructure. We use Docker, GitHub Actions, and Grafana to support deployment, automation, and observability, with a modular hexagonal monolith architecture.

You won't need to be hands-on with every technology, but you'll bring the technical understanding to challenge architectural decisions, navigate trade-offs, and support your engineers in solving complex problems.

What Success Looks Like:

By 3 months

  • You've built a strong understanding of our product, technology, engineering processes, and business objectives, establishing trusted relationships with your engineers and key stakeholders.

  • You've taken ownership of people management across your squads, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations, and an understanding of each engineer's strengths and development needs.

  • You've assessed current delivery practices, team structure, and performance, identifying opportunities to improve collaboration, predictability, and team effectiveness.

By 6 months

  • Your squads are operating with clear objectives, defined ownership, and measurable KPIs aligned with product and business priorities.

  • You've established effective delivery practices, with more predictable planning, proactive risk management, and improved visibility for stakeholders.

  • You've identified team capability gaps and are actively contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the development of engineers across your squads.

  • You're contributing meaningful improvements to engineering processes and organizational structure alongside the wider engineering management team.

By 12 months

  • Your squads consistently deliver against realistic, well-defined roadmaps, with clear accountability, effective collaboration, and measurable improvements in delivery performance.

  • Engineers have clear development paths, receive regular feedback, and feel supported in their growth, contributing to strong engagement and retention.

  • New engineers are onboarding efficiently and becoming productive quickly, supported by established processes and a clear engineering hiring bar.

  • You've helped shape a scalable engineering organization with well-defined squad ownership, effective ways of working, and stronger alignment between Engineering, Product, and the wider business.

  • Stakeholders have confidence in engineering delivery, with transparent communication, reliable planning, and fewer unexpected blockers.

What We're Looking For:

  • Proven experience directly managing and developing software engineers, ideally eight or more across multiple teams, within a growing engineering organization.

  • Demonstrated experience building or scaling engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and supporting engineers' career development.

  • A strong software engineering background with solid architectural fundamentals, enabling you to challenge technical decisions, understand trade-offs, and provide credible guidance.

  • Experience owning engineering delivery, translating product and business objectives into actionable plans, managing dependencies, and driving measurable outcomes.

  • A data-driven approach to engineering management, with experience using delivery metrics and team performance insights to identify and implement improvements.

  • The ability to establish effective engineering processes and ways of working that improve team performance without introducing unnecessary complexity.

  • Strong leadership and organizational skills, with the confidence to create structure, navigate ambiguity, and influence decisions in a scaling environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience collaborating effectively across distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working with Go (Golang) or managing teams building Go-based applications.

  • Familiarity with Shape Up or similar appetite-driven development methodologies.

  • Experience using DORA metrics to measure and improve engineering delivery.

  • Knowledge of Team Topologies and experience shaping squad structures as engineering teams scale.

  • Experience scaling an engineering organization from approximately 10 to 25 engineers.

  • Background in B2B SaaS, data-intensive products, or API-first platforms.

The Hiring Process:

  • Introduction to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 mins) - A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins) - A chance for you to meet our VP of Engineering and walk through your background, the teams you've led, what you've built and broken along the way.

  • Engineering management case study (60 mins) - A practical session grounded in a real situation: a hiring decision, a delivery slipping, a process that isn't being followed, a performance conversation.

  • Final Interview with our CEO (45 min) – A chance for you to meet our CEO, Ben and have a conversation around FullEnrich's ambitions, how we work and what we're building together.

title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

The Role

As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data.

You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs.

This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver.

You'll also play an important role in shaping how we approach technical pre-sales at Rivia, building repeatable processes, improving our demo environments, and helping us scale without losing the scientific depth and customer understanding that make us different.

What Excites You

  • Bringing science and technology together: You love understanding complex scientific challenges and translating them into practical, impactful solutions.

  • Being hands-on: You don't just talk about what a product can do. You enjoy building demos, configuring sandboxes, working with data, and showing customers what's possible.

  • Making an impact on revenue: You enjoy being part of the sales process, influencing strategic deals, and helping customers confidently make decisions.

  • Solving real customer problems: You're curious about how biotech and pharma companies operate and enjoy finding creative ways to address their challenges.

  • Building from the ground up: You get excited about joining a growing company where you can shape processes, improve tools, and help establish how technical pre-sales should work.

  • Working across teams: You enjoy collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering, balancing commercial opportunities with technical feasibility.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives as the scientific and technical expert throughout the sales process, helping prospects understand how Rivia can address their specific challenges.

  • Lead in-depth product demonstrations tailored to customers' clinical trial workflows, data structures, and scientific requirements.

  • Build and configure customized sandboxes, demo environments, and prototype integrations to demonstrate Rivia's value using realistic customer scenarios.

  • Understand customers' clinical trial pipelines, protocols, endpoints, and data challenges, translating their needs into practical technical solutions.

  • Scope prospective customer implementations, identifying technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and feasibility before commercial commitments are made.

  • Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers and Customer Engagement to ensure smooth handovers from pre-sales to implementation.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and internal teams, confidently addressing complex scientific questions while being transparent about product capabilities and limitations.

  • Adapt demonstrations and technical conversations to customers' familiarity with and readiness to adopt AI-driven solutions.

  • Identify recurring customer needs, technical objections, and product gaps, sharing insights with Product and Engineering to continuously improve our offering.

  • Help develop scalable pre-sales processes, reusable demo environments, and technical documentation as Rivia grows.

What Excites Us

  • Scientific background: You have a degree in life sciences, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, or a related scientific discipline, and you're comfortable navigating complex scientific discussions.

  • Relevant experience: You bring at least 4 years of client-facing experience in solutions consulting, technical pre-sales, field application science, technical account management, or similar roles.

  • Scientific and technical fluency: You understand scientific data and experimental logic, and can quickly grasp complex clinical trial workflows and technical requirements.

  • Hands-on technical skills: You've personally built and configured product demos, sandboxes, or technical proof-of-concepts, rather than only presenting solutions developed by others.

  • Commercial mindset: You understand how technical expertise contributes to winning deals and enjoy working closely with sales teams to move opportunities forward.

  • Customer-facing confidence: You can communicate complex technical concepts clearly and credibly, whether you're speaking with scientists, clinical operations leaders, or technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ownership: You're proactive, independent, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built.

  • Collaborative approach: You know when to challenge assumptions, push back on unrealistic commitments, and work across teams to deliver the best outcomes for customers.

Bonus / Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in scientific software, clinical trial technology, biotech platforms, or laboratory informatics.

  • Familiarity with clinical trial protocols, endpoints, regulatory considerations, and clinical data integration.

  • Experience working with AI-driven products or communicating the value of AI to scientific and technical stakeholders.

Our Values

  • In It to Win It: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive to achieve the best possible outcomes.

  • Embrace Change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why Not?: We challenge assumptions, stay curious, and explore new possibilities rather than accepting things as they are.

  • Find the Gap: We proactively identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and solve problems before they arise.

  • Collective Accountability: We're one team, on one mission, committed to shared responsibility, mutual support, and trust.

  • Value Add Solutions: Know better. Act better. We're dedicated to delivering meaningful solutions that create real impact.

Bei Oviva verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir wollen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich machen.

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Wir haben bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, Deutschland, Polen und Grossbritannien unterstützt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Jedes Gespräch, jedes Coaching und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte diese Zukunft aktiv mit.


Dein Verantwortungsbereich

Als Graduate / des. Ernährungsberater*in machst du dich Schritt für Schritt mit dem Arbeitsalltag einer Fachperson im ambulanten Beratungssetting vertraut und baust deine Handlungskompetenz kontinuierlich auf:

title: Ingénieur Sécurité des Procédés - Process Safety Engineer (H/F)
description:
📜 Contexte

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles.

Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés, vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie.

Votre rôle sera axé sur la prévention des accidents majeurs, la conformité aux standards et réglementations applicables, ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sécurité des procédés du site.

📌 Votre rôle

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés, vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés.

Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance, ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire.

Vos missions

🎯 Responsabilités

🔹 Analyse des risques procédés
• Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques procédés, notamment les études HAZOP, What-If et LOPA.
• Identifier les scénarios de risques potentiels et recommander les mesures de prévention et de protection adaptées.
• Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets.

🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique
• Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1.
• Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels.
• Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires.

🔹 Ingénierie & projets industriels
• Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles.
• Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés.
• Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception.

🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité
• Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC).
• Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise.

🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance
• Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés.
• Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques.
• Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Audits, réglementation & études de sécurité
• Participer aux audits et inspections de conformité réglementaire.
• Contribuer aux analyses quantitatives des risques (QRA), aux études de protection contre les explosions et aux autres évaluations de sécurité.
• Veiller au respect des standards et réglementations applicables en matière de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Formation & sensibilisation
• Former et sensibiliser le personnel aux principes et bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.
• Promouvoir une culture forte de la sécurité des procédés sur le site.
• Communiquer les exigences réglementaires et techniques aux interlocuteurs concernés.

Vos compétences

💼 Votre profil

• Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en génie chimique, chimie ou domaine équivalent.
• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en sécurité des procédés dans un environnement industriel chimique ou pharmaceutique.
• Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation d'études de sécurité des procédés.
• Maîtrise des méthodologies HAZOP, LOPA, SIL et ATEX.
• Bonne connaissance des standards internationaux de sécurité des procédés tels que API, CCPS, IEC 61511 et SEVESO.
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des P&ID, schémas de procédé et spécifications d'équipements.
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'aptitude à synthétiser des informations techniques complexes.
• Excellentes qualités de communication et capacités pédagogiques.
• Esprit d'équipe, proactivité et autonomie.
• Français courant et bon anglais technique, notamment pour la lecture et la rédaction de documents HSE internationaux.

Avantages

🏆 Conditions du poste

• 📍 Lieu : Genève, Suisse
• 🕒 Taux d'activité : 100 %
• 📅 Date de démarrage : flexible, à convenir

⚠️ Ce poste est ouvert aux candidat(e)s de nationalité suisse ou européenne (UE/AELE), ou titulaires d'un permis de travail valable pour la Suisse.

description:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Deputy MLRO (AML Compliance)

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

Nu Global AG is Nu's Swiss entity, based in Zug. It went live in October 2026 with its AML/CFT and sanctions framework already in place: entity risk analysis, internal directives, customer risk classification, monitoring and screening standards, and MROS reporting. The same team also drives the next steps of Nu's expansion in Europe.

We are looking for a senior AML professional to act as deputy to the Head of AML/CFTP & Sanctions. In 2027 you will take over the day to day MLRO duties of the Swiss entity, so the Head of AML can focus on strategy, and you will help take the framework built in Switzerland to new markets in Europe, adapting it to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6).

You will join a small, senior team where everyone owns their decisions and does the work themselves. You will work directly with senior management, the first line, our auditors and our regulators.

You'll be responsible for

  • Act as deputy to the AML Compliance Officer (MLRO) and stand in whenever needed

  • Run the day to day MLRO activities: escalated cases, decisions on reports to MROS under Art. 9 AMLA through goAML, and sanctions duties towards SECO, including asset freezes

  • Review and challenge the first line: sample based quality assurance of alert handling and case files, and sign off on changes to transaction monitoring rules and screening thresholds

  • Keep the framework current: entity risk analysis, internal directives and procedures, and the annual AML/CFT report to the Board

  • Issue the financial crime opinion on new products, features and material changes at the Product Risk Committee

  • Be the point of contact for our SRO, MROS, SECO and the external AML auditor, and for due diligence requests from partner and correspondent institutions

  • Own the AML/CFT training plan and the training duty under Art. 8 AMLA

  • As Nu expands in Europe, adapt the Swiss framework to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6) and turn it into binding control requirements for product, engineering and operations

We are looking for someone who has

  • Served as MLRO, AML Compliance Officer or formal deputy at a regulated financial intermediary in Switzerland, supervised by FINMA or an SRO, or in the EU (mandatory)

  • Lives in Switzerland today (mandatory)

  • Meets the fit and proper requirements that regulators apply to AML officers (mandatory)

  • Holds the CAMS certification (mandatory)

  • Speaks fluent English, our working language, and fluent German (mandatory)

  • Has practical experience with the Swiss AML framework (AMLA, AMLO, FINMA AMLO and SRO rules, MROS and SECO reporting), the EU AML framework, or both, and a working knowledge of the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6)

  • Has built or set up an AML function or framework

  • Has taken and defended reporting and freezing decisions, and has dealt directly with FINMA, SROs, other regulators and external auditors

  • Has reviewed and challenged first line controls at a senior level: transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, KYC and customer risk classification

  • Writes clearly and precisely in policies, opinions and regulatory correspondence

Nice to have

  • Sanctions expertise: screening, list management, asset freezes and reporting under Swiss and EU sanctions regimes

  • Experience with international remittances and cross border payments

  • Travel Rule compliance, including for digital assets

  • Experience in a fintech or in a newly authorised financial institution

  • Comfort using data and AI tools to review alerts, test controls and draft documentation

  • Other certifications such as CGSS, CCAS, Chainalysis Reactor or Chainalysis KYT (recommended)

Location for this opportunity

  • Zug, Switzerland (you must live in Switzerland today)

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents

  • Pension Plan

  • Accident Insurance

  • Daily Sickness Benefits

  • Life Insurance & Death Benefits

  • NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • International Travel Insurance for business trips

  • Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home

  • Parking space at the Zug office

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position description

We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles.


What you will do

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services.

  • Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems.

  • Implement and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including vaulting, session management, and just-in-time access.

  • Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls.

  • Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP.

  • Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations.

  • Secure cloud identity and access across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM policies, workload identity, and service accounts.

  • Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards, policies, and best practices.

  • Monitor identity-related threats and support detection and response for account compromise, credential abuse, and privilege escalation.


Experience and qualifications

  • 6 to 15 years of experience in IAM, security engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major IAM platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or CyberArk.

  • Strong knowledge of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos.

  • Experience with Active Directory and directory services architecture.

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Go, Java, or JavaScript).

  • Solid understanding of cloud IAM models (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM).

  • Experience with MFA, passwordless, and conditional or risk-based access.

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth principles.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Additional comments

This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. title: Senior Pricing Analyst
description:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

🌈 Belonging at Laka

We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. Onze producties zijn te vinden op https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb

Samenwerken en resultaatgericht werken staan daarbij centraal.

title: ad/mbo-stage Informatiebeheer, Documenten Ordenen & Kwaliteitszorg
description:
ad/mbo-praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij iemand die graag orde schept in de chaos?
Krijg je energie van uitzoeken, structureren en dingen overzichtelijk maken?
Werk je graag met digitale systemen?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

We hebben honderden documenten met informatie over ons beleid en genomen besluiten. Deze documenten zijn relevant voor veel collega’s. Om die reden willen we de documenten graag op een overzichtelijke manier aanbieden, zodat alle collega’s snel en makkelijk het document kunnen vinden dat ze zoeken. We hebben al een idee hoe we dit willen gaan doen. Tijdens jouw stage ga je ons idee verder uitwerken en in de praktijk toepassen.

Dit zijn de concrete activiteiten:

  • Je gaat alle beleidsdocumenten verzamelen die nu nog op verschillende plekken zijn opgeslagen.

  • Je maakt een mappenstructuur aan, waarin de documenten op een logische plek komen te staan.

  • Je deelt de documenten in volgens de nieuwe structuur en voorziet ze van labels en metadata voor een optimale vindbaarheid.

  • Je controleert of documenten dubbel voorkomen en verwijdert dubbele, verouderde en niet meer relevante documenten.

  • Je kijkt of de nieuwe structuur in de praktijk goed werkt en of gebruikers de documenten gemakkelijk kunnen terugvinden.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en doet waar nodig voorstellen voor verbeteringen.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen

Je loopt stage bij het team Staf van Dataverzameling (DVZ) van het CBS in Heerlen. Vanuit deze directie wordt een groot deel van de data verzameld die het CBS nodig heeft voor zijn werk. Je krijgt dus een kijkje achter de schermen bij een organisatie die dagelijks met veel verschillende soorten data werkt.
Jouw stageopdracht gaat over kwaliteitszorg voor alle teams binnen DVZ.

Je staat er tijdens je stage natuurlijk niet alleen voor: je hebt collega’s om je heen bij wie je terechtkunt met vragen en ideeën. De sfeer op de afdeling is informeel en gezellig. Collega’s zijn makkelijk aanspreekbaar en helpen elkaar graag. Natuurlijk wordt er hard gewerkt, maar er is ook tijd voor een praatje bij de koffieautomaat of een gezamenlijke lunch. Als je wilt, kun je tijdens de lunch ook aansluiten bij een lunchwandeling.
Kortom: je krijgt bij ons de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen, nieuwe dingen te leren en echt mee te werken in een team.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een ad- of mbo-opleiding informatiebeheer, administratie, business services of management support.

Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met:

  • Het werken met documenten en informatie en deze op een overzichtelijke manier ordenen.

  • Het werken met digitale programma’s en systemen en het snel wegwijs worden in nieuwe systemen.

  • Nauwkeurig en gestructureerd werken en het leuk vinden om dingen netjes en overzichtelijk te maken.

  • Samenwerken en overleggen met collega’s, vragen stellen en meedenken over hoe iets beter of makkelijker kan.

Je werkt graag netjes en gestructureerd, bent betrouwbaar en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te leren. Je pakt uit jezelf dingen op, denkt mee en stelt vragen als iets niet duidelijk is. Ook vind je het prettig om samen te werken en makkelijk contact te maken met collega’s.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • praktijkervaring opdoet met document- en informatiebeheer en leert hoe je informatie overzichtelijk en goed vindbaar maakt;

  • zelfstandig aan de slag gaat, maar ook samenwerkt en overlegt met collega’s;

  • leert hoe je duidelijk communiceert, vragen stelt en goed afstemt met je stagebegeleider;

  • leert om problemen en verbeterpunten op tijd te herkennen en deze samen met je collega’s te bespreken;

  • feedback krijgt en en toepast, zodat je tijdens je stage steeds meer leert en groeit in je werkzaamheden.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

title: Productmanager Data & Webdiensten
description:
Ben jij een inspirator die strategische IT-doelen weet te operationaliseren en innovatie binnen je team stimuleert? Wil jij een veilige en moderne generieke technische IT-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden? En zorg jij ervoor dat de dagelijkse operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt?

Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Productmanager Data en Webdiensten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en realisatie van de productroadmap en begeleid je de processen die nodig zijn om onze producten en diensten conform de geldende kaders te realiseren. Samen met 13 collega's werk je aan het dagelijks operationeel houden en verder ontwikkelen van onze technische IT-dienstverlening.

Een belangrijke ontwikkeling is de verdere uitbreiding van selfservice, onder andere door de inzet van Infrastructure as Code en het via API's ontsluiten van onze diensten. Daarbij staan veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie centraal. Onze diensten voldoen vanaf het ontwerp aan de geldende CIS- en ISO-kaders, waarbij het naleven van security- en compliancebeleid prioriteit heeft.

Je begeleidt een team van 10 tot 15 engineers en senior engineers bij Agile werken en de inhoudelijke productontwikkeling. Je stimuleert een proactieve werkwijze en zorgt voor de verbinding tussen strategische doelstellingen en de dagelijkse uitvoering. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega-productmanagers, architecten, servicemanagers, beheerteams en andere stakeholders.

Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Je ontwikkelt een samenhangende productstrategie en visie voor de productsuite van het team Data en Webdiensten en stemt deze af met het hoofd IGI en andere stakeholders. Hierin borg je naast vernieuwing ook veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie.

  • Je vertaalt de vastgestelde productstrategie en visie naar een meerjarige roadmap, kwartaalplanningen en een productbacklog.

  • Je organiseert en begeleidt Agile-events, waaronder dagstarts, sprintplanningen, sprintreviews, retrospectives en refinements, zowel binnen als buiten het eigen team. Daarnaast coach je teamleden.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor technische teams, architecten, Security Services, Contracts & Finance en servicemanagement. Je bevordert de samenwerking en zorgt voor afstemming over productdoelen en -strategieën.

  • Je onderhoudt contact met afnemers en andere productmanagers, verzamelt feedback en vertaalt hun uitdagingen en behoeften naar de verdere productontwikkeling.

  • Je ontwikkelt samen met het hoofd IGI en andere productmanagers KPI's en succesmaatstaven, bijvoorbeeld voor adoptie, efficiëntie, kosten en productiviteit van engineers. Je maakt de prestaties van geleverde diensten inzichtelijk en houdt toezicht op veiligheid, compliance, beschikbaarheid en performance. Hiervoor benut je bestaande inzichten vanuit servicemanagement en ontwikkel je waar nodig aanvullende inzichten.


Je toekomstige collega's

Je werkt in het team Data en Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). Deze afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 experts, verdeeld over onze locaties in Heerlen en Den Haag. Het team Data en Webdiensten telt circa 15 collega's die eveneens op beide locaties werkzaam zijn.

We werken volgens een Agile-methodiek in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage aan deze werkwijze vinden we belangrijk. Dit betekent onder andere het opstellen van kwalitatief goede stories en epics, het actueel houden van stories op het Azure DevOps-bord en een actieve, constructieve deelname aan dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Samenwerking, continu verbeteren en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk. Dit is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.


Dit ben jij

Je bent een initiatiefrijke, ondernemende en zelfstandige productmanager die strategisch inzicht weet te combineren met technische basiskennis. Je begrijpt de technische uitdagingen van onze infrastructuurdiensten en kunt hierover effectief communiceren met zowel engineers als andere stakeholders.

Je beschikt over methodische kennis van Agile en Scrum en weet hoe je samenwerking en continue verbetering binnen een team stimuleert. Je kunt strategisch denken, relevante markttrends herkennen en deze vertalen naar een productvisie. Daarbij weet je verschillende belangen en behoeften met elkaar te verbinden.

Je hebt een sterke ambitie om de user- en customer experience maximaal te faciliteren. Continu samen verbeteren zit in jouw DNA. Je ziet kansen om onze dienstverlening verder te ontwikkelen en neemt initiatief om verbeteringen daadwerkelijk te realiseren.

Daarbij herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je beschikt over technische basiskennis en hebt begrip van API's, cloudsystemen en software- en/of infrastructuurarchitectuur.

  • Je hebt kennis van Agile en Scrum en beschikt over de methodische vaardigheden om deze werkwijzen toe te passen.

  • Je beschikt over sterke sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden om effectief samen te werken met engineers en stakeholders.

  • Je bent in staat om strategisch te denken en markttrends te vertalen naar een duidelijke productvisie.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en ondernemend, neemt initiatief en stimuleert een proactieve manier van werken.

  • Je bent gericht op continu samen verbeteren en hebt oog voor de behoeften en ervaringen van gebruikers en afnemers.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4818,- en maximaal € 7094,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. title: Senior Databasebeheerder (deeltijd 16 uur)
description:
Ben jij een ervaren databasespecialist die zijn technische expertise wil inzetten voor complexe vraagstukken en de verdere ontwikkeling van een modern dataplatform? Wil je bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige databasediensten binnen een maatschappelijke organisatie, maar zoek je bewust een functie voor 16 uur per week? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Senior Database Specialist versterk je ons team met specialistische kennis van Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL. Je richt je vooral op complexe technische vraagstukken, verbeteringen en vernieuwing. De dagelijkse operatie ligt bij het team; jij helpt juist daar waar extra expertise, verdieping of richting nodig is.

Onze databasediensten vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van de technische infrastructuur van het CBS. Beschikbaarheid, performance, veiligheid en continuïteit zijn daarbij essentieel. Tegelijkertijd ontwikkelen we onze dienstverlening verder door meer te automatiseren, nieuwe databaseservices te onderzoeken en onze infrastructuur verder te moderniseren.

Met jouw ervaring help je het team bij vraagstukken die verder gaan dan het dagelijkse beheer. Je analyseert complexe problemen, adviseert over technische keuzes en helpt structurele verbeteringen te realiseren. Daarbij werk je zowel met onze bestaande MSSQL- en PostgreSQL-omgevingen als aan de ontwikkeling van toekomstige databasediensten.

Omdat je 16 uur per week werkt, ligt de nadruk op werkzaamheden waarvoor jouw senior expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt:

  • analyseren en oplossen van complexe vraagstukken rondom MSSQL en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance, troubleshooting en database-optimalisatie;

  • adviseren over databasearchitectuur, high availability, disaster recovery, lifecycle management en de verwerking van grote hoeveelheden data;

  • initiëren en uitvoeren van structurele technische verbeteringen en bijdragen aan upgrades, migraties en automatisering van databasewerkzaamheden;

  • bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe databasediensten, waaronder Database as a Service en toekomstige technologieën zoals graphdatabases;

  • meedenken over de verdere modernisering van het platform, waaronder containerisatie, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code en CI/CD;

  • verbeteren van monitoring, logging, capaciteitsbeheer, back-up- en restorevoorzieningen, encryptie, autorisaties en informatiebeveiliging en jouw kennis delen met collega’s en andere technische specialisten.


Je toekomstige collega's

Je komt te werken in Team Data & Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). De afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 IT-professionals die werkzaam zijn vanuit Heerlen en Den Haag. Het Team Data & Webdiensten bestaat uit ongeveer 15 collega’s.

Binnen het team werken we Agile in combinatie met ITIL. We gebruiken Azure DevOps om het werk inzichtelijk te maken en werken met stories en epics. Ook nemen we deel aan vaste momenten zoals dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Met 16 uur per week maak je volwaardig onderdeel uit van het team, maar verwachten we niet dat je iedere operationele taak oppakt. In overleg bepalen we waar jouw expertise het meeste verschil kan maken. Je werkt daardoor nauw samen met de collega’s die dagelijks verantwoordelijk zijn voor de databasediensten en ondersteunt hen bij complexere technische vraagstukken en ontwikkelingen.
We werken met collega’s op verschillende locaties en vanuit verschillende specialismen. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een ervaren databasespecialist die snel tot de kern van een technisch vraagstuk komt. Je hoeft niet voortdurend bij de dagelijkse operatie betrokken te zijn om te begrijpen wat er speelt en bent in staat om binnen je beschikbare tijd duidelijke prioriteiten te stellen.

Je combineert diepgaande databasekennis met een bredere blik op infrastructuur, automatisering en security. Je denkt niet alleen in tijdelijke oplossingen, maar zoekt naar structurele verbeteringen die ook op langere termijn waarde toevoegen.

Daarnaast kun je jouw technische afwegingen helder uitleggen. Je werkt gemakkelijk samen met andere technische disciplines, deelt je kennis en kunt collega’s adviseren zonder het werk van hen over te nemen.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • hbo-werk- en denkniveau en meerdere jaren relevante ervaring met het ontwerpen, beheren en optimaliseren van databaseomgevingen;

  • aantoonbare en diepgaande ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance tuning, troubleshooting, back-up/restore en high availability;

  • ervaring met Windows- en Linux-serveromgevingen en automatisering met bijvoorbeeld PowerShell, Bash en/of Python;

  • kennis van databasebeveiliging, waaronder encryptie, autorisaties, informatiebeveiliging en compliance;

  • kennis van Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD en DevOps-werkwijzen en bij voorkeur ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Ansible;

  • kennis van ITIL-processen, sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding gericht op kennisdeling en continue verbetering.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Microsoft SQL Server en/of PostgreSQL zijn een pré.


Feitelijk goed geregeld

Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. title: Mid Market Account Executive - Benelux
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is a leader in a dynamic market. As a public company listed on the NYSE with $2.1B in ARR, we deliver mission-critical solutions to physical operations globally. This position is tailored for high-performing professionals seeking to accelerate their professional growth. We are seeking account managers to oversee deal sizes ranging from €10k to €300k across a comprehensive suite of 15+ product solutions, engaging key decision-makers including Finance Directors and Managing Directors. Joining our team offers the autonomy and support to tackle challenging objectives and drive impactful results.

While this position offers remote flexibility across the Netherlands, periodic travel to meet clients on-site is expected (typically bi-weekly).

In this role you will:

Advantageous:

title: Accounts Payable & Financial Controller
description:
Als Accounts Payable & Financial Controller ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van onze financiële administratie — een van de belangrijkste pijlers voor het nemen van beslissingen binnen Crisp. Wat wij bieden

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.
